fn converted(fail: bool, expected_line: &mut u32) -> Result<u32, $PARENT> {
    *expected_line = line!() + 1;
    let value = operation(fail)?;
    Ok(value)
}

fn main() {
    let fail = std::env::args().any(|argument| argument == "fail");
    let mut expected_line = 0;
    match converted(fail, &mut expected_line) {
        Ok(value) => {
            assert_eq!(value, leaf(false));
            println!("{}", value + 1);
        }
        Err(error) => {
            let native = std::error::Error::source(&error)
                .and_then(|source| source.downcast_ref::<$SOURCE>())
                .expect("parent must expose native source");
            assert_eq!(native.line, expected_line);
            assert_eq!(native.file, file!());
            let original = std::error::Error::source(native)
                .and_then(|source| source.downcast_ref::<std::io::Error>())
                .expect("native source must retain the typed foreign error");
            assert_eq!(original.kind(), std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied);
            assert!(std::error::Error::source(original).is_none());
            assert!(error.to_string().contains(&format!("{}:{expected_line}", file!())));
            // Direct conversion also retains a custom payload, not just its text.
            let source = std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, Payload(31));
            let expected_line = line!() + 1;
            let direct = $PARENT::from(source);
            let native = std::error::Error::source(&direct)
                .and_then(|source| source.downcast_ref::<$SOURCE>()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(native.line, expected_line);
            let source = std::error::Error::source(native)
                .and_then(|source| source.downcast_ref::<std::io::Error>()).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(source.get_ref().and_then(|inner| inner.downcast_ref::<Payload>()).unwrap().0, 31);
            println!("typed source and caller location preserved");
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Payload(u32);

impl std::fmt::Display for Payload {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "payload {}", self.0)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for Payload {}
